body: Credibility-generated forward test (NOT a recommendation; not buy/sell). Probability 0.51 (naive sector base rate 0.39) that: Sona BLW closes JV2 (high-voltage e-powertrain JV with Denso) by 30-Jun-2027. Probability set only by the pre-stated rule (research_notes/Promise tracker pilot/AUTO_COMPONENTS_peer_comparison.md section 5): p0 = 0.39 (leave-one-out peer strict delivery rate, category 'other', n=15); SAC +50.0 pts x weight 0.231 (N=6) -> p = 0.51. Evidence: Q2FY27 call (26-Oct-2026): 'JV2 has not yet formed up but we are targeting to close and have it sometime in the 1st half of calendar year 2027.' Resolution: YES if an NSE filing or company communication states JV2 was formed/closed (definitive agreements executed and transaction completed) on or before 30-Jun-2027. Source: NSE announcements (SONACOMS); Q4 FY27 / Q1 FY28 call. Resolve by 2027-07-31; score with Brier vs the base rate, to test whether the credibility adjustment adds skill.

data.adjustment_applied: p0 = 0.39 (leave-one-out peer strict delivery rate, category 'other', n=15); SAC +50.0 pts x weight 0.231 (N=6) -> p = 0.51
data.adjustment_rule: p0 = leave-one-out pooled STRICT delivery rate (specificity-weighted share 'delivered'; partly=0) of the other 4 peers in the promise's category (all-category peer rate if <8 peer promises in that category). p = clip(p0 + N/(N+20) x SAC/100, 0.05, 0.95), N = company's scored promises, SAC in points (credit basis: delivered 1, partly 0.5; categories with n<5, or with <2 peers having data, pooled). P(base) = p0.
data.base_rate_reasoning: Naive forecaster = sector delivery rate for 'other' promises among the other auto-component peers (strict: delivered only, specificity-weighted; n=15). No company-specific information.
data.resolution_rule: YES if an NSE filing or company communication states JV2 was formed/closed (definitive agreements executed and transaction completed) on or before 30-Jun-2027.
data.resolution_source: NSE announcements (SONACOMS); Q4 FY27 / Q1 FY28 call
